full_judgment: 4. The Government of Bangladesh as defendant No. 2 also contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations, contending inter alia that temporary licence was issued only after obtaining a no objection certificate from the concerned Thana Nirbahi Officer, to exhibit films in the said cinema hall in accordance with the provisions of section 3 of the Cinema Autograph Act, 1918. After hearing, the learned Assistant Judge by his judgment and decree dated 7.10.1996 decreed the suit. On appeal, being Other Class Appeal No. 267 of 1997, the learned Additional District Judge, Second Court, Kishoreganj allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit.
